title: Binary search: halve the range every step

steps.caption: Find 23 in a sorted array. Look at the middle; one comparison discards half the range.
a[4] = 16 < 23: the target must be to the right. lo = mid + 1.
a[7] = 56 > 23: the target must be to the left. hi = mid − 1.
a[5] = 23. Found in 3 looks instead of up to 10.
